aerobicInfo: Aerobics is a form of physical activity that involves rhythmic and continuous movements designed to increase heart rate and improve cardiovascular health. It can be performed with or without equipment, most often to music, and engages the entire body. Aerobics improves endurance, burns calories, and boosts energy levels. It is suitable for all ages and fitness levels, and regular practice brings visible health and fitness benefits.
stepAerobicSubtitle: Step Aerobics is a classic aerobic workout performed using a step platform. Through rhythmic steps and choreographed movements, heart rate is elevated and cardiovascular capacity is improved. The movements are coordinated with music, making the workout dynamic and enjoyable.
stepAerobicSubSubtitle: This training primarily targets the lower body, while also improving balance and endurance. It is excellent for burning calories, enhancing motor skills, and building fitness without putting excessive stress on the joints.
kickboxAerobicSubtitle: Kickbox Aerobics is an energetic cardio workout that combines kickboxing techniques with rhythmic aerobic movements. Through punches, kicks, and jumps, the body works intensively, burning calories while improving strength, speed, and coordination.
kickboxAerobicSubSubtitle: This workout strengthens the entire body, reduces stress, and allows the release of excess energy. It is ideal for those who enjoy dynamic, action-packed cardio challenges with visible fitness results.
lowImpactAerobicSubtitle: Low Impact Aerobics is a gentle yet effective form of aerobic training that does not include jumping or sudden movements, making it ideal for beginners, older adults, or those who need a workout with reduced stress on the joints.
lowImpactAerobicSubSubtitle: The movements are performed at a moderate tempo and are aimed at improving cardiovascular capacity, coordination, and light body toning. Although it is “low impact,” the workout is structured to still provide visible results.
zumbaSubtitle: Zumba is a fun dance-fitness workout inspired by Latin and international rhythms. It combines cardio movements, simple choreography, and energetic music to create an effective and engaging workout. Suitable for all ages and levels, Zumba burns stress and calories while bringing a smile.
zumbaSubSubtitle: Without feeling like you are exercising, you will experience the benefits - for your heart, body, and spirit.
bfitTeenInfo: B-Fit Teen is a specially designed program as part of our wide-spectrum offer, intended for children aged 9 to 15. Through precisely dosed physical exercises — in terms of intensity, type, and duration — the program is used both preventively, for children with predispositions to postural disorders, and therapeutically, when such conditions are already present. The focus is on proper motor development and maintaining a healthy and functional body during a critical developmental period.
bfitTeenCoreFunctionSubtitle: The goal of B-Fit Teen is to enable normal functioning of the locomotor system in children through physical activity that includes precise execution of spatial and temporal elements of movement.
bfitTeenCoreFunctionSubSubtitle: This discipline is particularly important during the growth and developmental phase, when the body is most susceptible to change and can be effectively guided toward proper musculoskeletal development.
benefitsOfBfitTitle: Benefits of the B-Fit Teen Program
benefitsOfBfitSubtitleSix: Maintenance of a healthy body weight
benefitsOfBfitSubtitleSeven: Through play and social interaction – happiness, self-confidence, and socialization
functionalFitnessInfo: Functional Fitness is a type of training that prepares the body for real, everyday movements — such as sitting, lifting, twisting, and pushing. It is based on exercises that activate multiple muscle groups at the same time while improving mobility, balance, strength, and coordination.Instead of isolated movements, every workout has a practical purpose. It is equally beneficial for athletes and beginners, as it makes the body functional, healthy, and ready for daily life.
crossFitSubtitle: CrossFit is a high-intensity functional training program that combines elements of weightlifting, cardio, gymnastics, and bodyweight exercises. Each workout is different and performed in short, intense intervals (WOD – Workout of the Day).
crossFitSubSubtitle: The goal is to develop strength, endurance, explosiveness, and mental discipline. CrossFit is ideal for those who seek challenge, energy, and continuous progress — without monotony, as every day brings a new experience.
bodySculptSubtitle: BodySculpt is a body-toning workout focused on defining and sculpting muscles through controlled exercises using light weights, resistance bands, exercise balls, and bodyweight movements. The workout activates the entire body, especially the abdominal muscles, glutes, thighs, and arms.
bodySculptSubSubtitle: BodySculpt is not focused on building mass, but on achieving a lean and firm appearance. It is ideal for those who want visible results with a controlled pace and emphasis on precision.
circuitTrainingSubtitle: Circuit Training is an effective fitness method that combines several different exercises performed at consecutive stations with short rest intervals. It targets cardio, strength, balance, and endurance within a single session.
circuitTrainingSubSubtitle: The pace ranges from moderate to high, and the format can easily be adapted to different fitness levels. Circuit Training is ideal for fast results, calorie burning, and improving overall fitness — without routine or boredom.
totalBodyWorkoutSubtitle: Total Body Workout is a functional training session that activates the entire body through a combination of strength, cardio, and mobility exercises. It incorporates various equipment (weights, resistance bands, balls) as well as bodyweight exercises to improve muscular endurance, toning, and overall body transformation.
totalBodyWorkoutSubSubtitle: The exercises are carefully combined to engage every muscle group and achieve a complete fitness effect. It is suitable for both beginners and more experienced participants.
latinAMericanDancesInfo: Latin American dances are an energetic and technically precise discipline within ballroom sport dancing, included in the official competitive system of the World DanceSport Federation (WDSF). Samba, Cha-Cha-Cha, Rumba, Paso Doble, and Jive are taught and performed according to strictly defined WDSF standards and judging criteria.At Dance Sport Club “Branimir & Brankica,” these dances are taught professionally, using a methodology that prepares dancers for performances and competitions on both national and international stages.
sambaSubtitle: Samba is an energetic and rhythmic dance of Brazilian origin, known for its characteristic bouncing action and vibrant movements. It is danced in pairs and includes bent knees, quick steps, and fluid rotations.
sambaSubSubtitle: Samba radiates joy, passion, and carnival energy, making it one of the most impressive disciplines in the Latin style.
chaChaSubtitle: Cha-Cha-Cha is a cheerful and playful dance that originated in Cuba. It is characterized by the rhythm “two – three – cha-cha,” creating a lively and dynamic movement pattern.
chaChaSubSubtitle: With sharp steps, hip actions, and flirtatious sequences, Cha-Cha-Cha offers an excellent opportunity for musical expression and enjoyment on the dance floor.
rumbaSubtitle: Rumba is the most romantic of the Latin dances, recognized for its slow tempo, sensual movements, and deep emotional expression. It also originates from Cuba and is based on telling a love story through dance.
rumbaSubSubtitle: With pronounced hip movement and careful communication between partners, Rumba is elegant and profoundly expressive.
pasoDobleSubtitle: Paso Doble is a dramatic and theatrical dance inspired by the Spanish bullfight, where the male dancer represents the matador and the female partner symbolizes his cape.
pasoDobleSubSubtitle: With a marching rhythm, sharp lines, and powerful presentation, this dance conveys pride, control, and strong stage presence. Paso Doble requires confident posture and commanding expression, making it a true spectacle.
jiveSubtitle: Jive is the fastest and most playful of the Latin dances, with American origins. It is performed at a quick tempo with lively steps, kicks, and energetic movements.
jiveSubSubtitle: Although technically demanding and requiring good stamina, Jive delivers infectious energy and a constant sense of joy. It is the perfect blend of sport and fun on the dance floor.
painReleifInfo: Pain Relief is a specialized type of exercise class designed to help individuals who face daily body pain caused by poor posture, prolonged sitting, physical inactivity, excess weight, improper nutrition, or injuries. These classes are carefully structured to meet the needs of participants with existing physical conditions such as back, neck, knee, foot, and shoulder pain, as well as conditions like Scoliosis, Kyphosis, Spondylosis, Herniated Disc, and Sciatica.
painReleifSubInfo: This class is also highly attended by professional athletes and trainers who exercise to relieve, rebalance, and rehabilitate a tense and overworked body.
howDoesPainReleifWorksSubtitle: The exercises in Pain Relief classes are adjusted to an appropriate pace and intensity to avoid placing additional stress on the body. The program is designed to activate, stretch, and strengthen key muscle groups, helping the body and muscular system return to proper balance.
howDoesPainReleifWorksSubSubtitle: Sessions are led by professional instructors who focus on correct technique, breathing support, and body awareness, allowing for safe and effective rehabilitation.
directSolutionSubtitle: This approach works because it treats the root cause of the problem — not just the symptoms — through targeted therapeutic exercises that restore body function and mobility. The exercises are based on principles of prevention, stabilization, and recovery, making them ideal for people with chronic pain as well as professional athletes who want to relax and rebalance their bodies.
directSolutionSubSubtitle: Pain Relief is a universal, side-effect-free alternative suitable for all ages and genders.
personalTrainingInfo: Everybody has their own story, their own goals, and their own rhythm. That’s why personal training is not a luxury — it’s the most effective way to achieve the results you want, without injuries, without wasting time, and with maximum attention focused entirely on you.
whatWeOfferSubtitle: Our personal training sessions are fully individualized. We begin with an assessment of your body, fitness level, posture, and personal goals — whether it’s improving your shape, rehabilitation, reducing pain, increasing strength, or simply getting back into movement.
whatWeOfferSubSubtitle: We then create a program designed specifically for you, combining functional exercises, Pilates, stabilization, mobility work, and, when needed, corrective or therapeutic elements.
forWhoIsIntendedSubTitle: For everyone. Whether you are a beginner, returning after an injury, or looking to work on yourself in a deeper and more effective way — personal training is your safest, fastest, and most reliable solution. Each session is your space, your rhythm, and your strength.
forWhoIsIntendedSubSubTitle: Contact us to schedule your first personal training session or assessment. Together, we will create a plan tailored specifically to you — because your body deserves personalized attention.
pilatesInfo: Pilates is an exercise method that strengthens the muscles, especially the core, and improves posture, flexibility, and body awareness. It is performed through controlled, precise movements combined with proper breathing. It is suitable for all levels, including rehabilitation and sports support. With regular practice, Pilates develops a strong, stable, and balanced body with improved coordination and endurance.
matPilatesSubtitle: Mat Pilates is performed on a mat and represents the essence of the original Pilates method developed by Joseph Pilates. It focuses on strengthening the core, improving flexibility and coordination, and stabilizing the spine.
matPilatesSubSubtitle: The exercises are performed with controlled movements, body awareness, and proper breathing. Without the need for equipment, Mat Pilates is perfect for beginners, while also offering advanced variations for more experienced practitioners. This style is excellent for reducing back pain, improving posture, and restoring balance in the body.
fitBallPilatesSubtitle: Fitball Pilates uses a large stability ball (fitball) to challenge balance and activate the deep stabilizing muscles of the body. Through specific exercises performed on or supported by the ball, the core muscles are strengthened, posture is improved, and joint mobility is enhanced.
fitBallPilatesSubSubtitle: Fitball exercises offer effective rehabilitation, as well as a challenge for more advanced participants, thanks to the unstable surface that requires focus, concentration, and control. This type of Pilates is ideal for those who want to improve coordination, activate the entire body musculature, and enjoy the process.
ringBosuPilatesSubtitle: Our Pilates programs include three effective tools for a diverse and functional workout.Ring Pilates uses a resistance ring to activate the inner musculature.Bosu Pilates is performed on an unstable platform to strengthen balance and stability.
ringBosuPilatesSubSubtitle: Pilates Band uses elastic resistance bands to increase strength, flexibility, and control.Each method offers a unique approach to improving posture, muscle tone, and body awareness.
reformerSubtitle: Our studio also includes specialized Pilates equipment:Cadillac for supported and versatile spring-based exercises,Pilates Chair to challenge the core and balance,Spine Corrector for stretching and spinal alignment correction, and Ladder Barrel for improving flexibility and posture.
reformerSubSubtitle: The combination of these apparatuses enables a complete, precise, and personalized Pilates workout for every body.
prevCoreGymInfo: Preventive corrective gymnastics is a specialized type of physical activity designed for children with improper posture or at risk of developing postural deformities. It is carried out through carefully selected and properly dosed exercises in terms of intensity, type, and duration, with the goal of ensuring healthy development of the musculoskeletal system. In our club, this program is part of a broad range of services and is conducted by a professional team with experience working with children.
preventiveFunctionSubtitle: This approach is intended for preschool and school-age children who show predispositions to spinal, leg, or foot misalignments. Through precisely controlled exercises, children improve their posture, learn proper movement patterns, and develop a healthy body from an early age.
corectiveFunctionAndBenefitsSubtitle: If a deformity has already developed, corrective gymnastics has a therapeutic effect - reducing pain, improving muscle balance, increasing joint mobility, and stabilizing posture.
corectiveFunctionAndBenefitsSubSubtitle: Additionally, it enhances cardiovascular function, increases flexibility and endurance, and through play and social interaction, children gain a sense of joy and confidence in movement.
reformerInfo: The Reformer is one of the most well-known and visually impressive Pilates machines, designed by Joseph Pilates. Alongside the Cadillac (Pilates equipment) for supported and versatile spring-based work, the Pilates Chair for challenging the core and balance, the Spine Corrector for spinal stretching and correction, and the Ladder Barrel for improving flexibility and posture, these devices together provide a complete, precise, and personalized Pilates workout for every body.
reformerSubtitle: The Reformer consists of a moving carriage with springs, a sliding platform, and straps that provide resistance and support with every movement. It allows precise full-body training — from strengthening and toning muscles to improving flexibility, posture, and body awareness.
reformerSubSubtitle: It is suitable for all levels, from rehabilitation to advanced functional training.
pilatesChairSubtitle: The Pilates Chair is a compact yet highly challenging piece of equipment designed to strengthen the core muscles, improve balance, and develop total body control. It is used for both seated and standing exercises, with springs that provide adjustable resistance.
pilatesChairSubSubtitle: It is ideal for improving stability, endurance, and building strength with minimal joint strain.
spineCorrectorSubtitle: The Spine Corrector is a curved structure used for stretching, mobilizing, and strengthening the muscles surrounding the spine. It is excellent for improving posture, flexibility, and body alignment.
spineCorrectorSubSubtitle: It is especially beneficial for individuals experiencing back pain or limited mobility in the thoracic (mid-back) area.
ladderBarrelSubtitle: The Ladder Barrel combines a rounded surface with ladder rungs, allowing a wide range of exercises for stretching, stabilization, and torso rotation work.
ladderBarrelSubSubtitle: It is often used to improve posture, strengthen the posterior chain, and enhance spinal mobility. It offers a unique approach to advanced Pilates practice.
cadillacSubtitle: The Cadillac Reformer, or simply “Cadillac,” is designed to offer a wide range of full-body exercises — from deep core strengthening to stretching, mobility, and rehabilitation
cadillacSubSubtitle: With its stable platform, overhead frame, and versatile attachments such as springs, bars, straps, trapeze, and pulleys, the Cadillac allows exercises in various positions - lying down, seated, standing, or even suspended.It is perfect for both beginners and advanced practitioners, providing support, control, and precision in every movement.
zumbaInfo: Zumba is a fun dance-fitness workout inspired by Latin and international rhythms. It combines cardio movements, simple choreography, and energetic music to create an effective and addictive workout. Suitable for all ages and fitness levels, Zumba burns stress and calories while bringing a smile to your face. Without feeling like you’re exercising, you’ll experience the benefits – for your heart, body, and spirit.
zumbaFitnessSubtitle: Zumba Fitness is the original and most popular Zumba format – a cardio dance workout inspired by Latin and international rhythms. It combines simple choreography with movements from salsa, merengue, reggaeton, and samba, keeping the body in constant motion.
zumbaFitnessSubSubtitle: This workout burns calories, improves endurance, and gives you a feeling of energy and joy. Zumba Fitness is more than just exercise – it’s a fitness party that improves both your body and your mood.
zumbaToningSubtitle: Zumba Toning combines fun Zumba movements with light weights (toning sticks) to shape and strengthen muscles. While following the rhythm of Latin music, you simultaneously work on muscle tone, stability, and coordination.
zumbaToningSubSubtitle: The workout focuses on the core, arms, and lower body. It is ideal for those who want to dance while also building a stronger and more sculpted body.
zumbaStepSubtitle: Zumba Step combines the energetic Zumba style with the challenge of a step platform. It focuses on shaping the legs and glutes while keeping your heart rate in a constant calorie-burning zone.
zumbaStepSubSubtitle: The steps are rhythmic and musically synchronized, creating a dynamic yet controlled and intense workout. It is ideal for those who want extra focus on the lower body without losing the fun spirit of classic Zumba.
yogaInfo: Yoga is an ancient practice that connects the body, mind, and spirit through movement (asanas), breathing, and meditation. In addition to physical benefits such as flexibility, strength, and balance, it also offers mental clarity, stress reduction, and inner peace.Yoga can be gentle or intense, adaptable for all ages and levels, and represents a path toward better health, awareness, and personal balance.
hathaYogaSubtitle: Hatha Yoga is a traditional form of yoga that focuses on balancing the body and mind through asanas (postures), pranayama (breathing techniques), and relaxation. The practice follows a slower pace, with longer holds in each posture, allowing for deeper body awareness and stretching.
hathaYogaSubSubtitle: It is ideal for beginners, as well as for anyone seeking a deeper connection with themselves through a calm, stable, and holistic approach.
ashtangaYogaSubtitle: Ashtanga Yoga is a dynamic and structured style of yoga that follows a fixed sequence of postures connected with breathing (ujjayi) and internal focus (drishti). Each session presents both a physical and mental challenge, with emphasis on strength, endurance, and discipline.
ashtangaYogaSubSubtitle: This practice is ideal for those who value consistency, self-reflection, and personal growth through a regular and active yoga routine.
vinyasaYogaSubtitle: Vinyasa Flow Yoga is a fluid and creative form of yoga where movements are linked with the breath in a continuous “flow.” There is no fixed sequence of poses, allowing space for variety and freedom of expression.
vinyasaYogaSubSubtitle: The rhythm can be calm or intense, depending on the focus. It is ideal for those who enjoy diversity, energy, and meditative movement within one practice.
powerYogaSubtitle: Power Yoga is a modern, strength-based, fitness-oriented style inspired by Ashtanga Yoga. It is performed at a faster pace, focusing on building strength, endurance, and muscle tone.
powerYogaSubSubtitle: This practice is intense and activates the entire body while maintaining the yogic principles of presence and conscious breathing. It is perfect for those seeking a physical challenge and visible fitness results through yoga.
restorativeYogaSubtitle: Restorative Yoga is a quiet, therapeutic practice focused on complete relaxation and regeneration. It is performed with the support of bolsters, blankets, and props, with long holds in comfortable poses, without strain or effort.
restorativeYogaSubSubtitle: The focus is on breathing, awareness, and stress release, allowing the body to calm and the nervous system to rebalance.This type of yoga is ideal for those in need of rest, recovery, and a return to inner balance.
socialDancesInfo: Social dances are partner dances focused on fun, connection, and enjoying the music rather than competition. They are part of everyday life in many cultures and are danced at parties, festivals, and night outings. From the explosive energy of salsa to the sensual flow of kizomba, social dances offer the opportunity to move freely, express yourself, and connect with others through rhythm and movement.
salsaSubtitle: Salsa is the most well-known Latin dance, recognized for its energy, fast rhythm, and infectious movements. It originated in Cuba, and today there are different styles such as LA, New York, and Cuban salsa.
salsaSubSubtitle: Dancing salsa means communicating with your partner through fluid steps, turns, and musical expression. It is perfect for those who enjoy dynamics, fun, and vibrant energy on the dance floor.
bachataSubtitle: Bachata is a romantic and intimate dance from the Dominican Republic, recognizable for its soft steps and pronounced hip movement. The modern style of bachata (modern or sensual) emphasizes partner connection and musical interpretation of emotion.
bachataSubSubtitle: Bachata is ideal for those who prefer a slower tempo, closeness, and expression through smooth yet expressive movements.
merengueSubtitle: Merengue is the national dance of the Dominican Republic and one of the easiest and most enjoyable dances to learn. It is characterized by alternating steps from foot to foot and rhythmic hip movement.
merengueSubSubtitle: It is danced to an upbeat, lively rhythm and creates a cheerful, friendly atmosphere. It is perfect for beginners and anyone who wants to move without complicated choreography.
kizombaSubtitle: Kizomba is a sensual Afro-Lusophone dance originating from Angola. It is danced in a close embrace, with smooth and controlled movements at a tempo that allows emotional expression and musical interpretation.
kizombaSubSubtitle: Kizomba does not require speed, but sensitivity and connection with the partner. It is popular among those seeking depth, softness, and intensity in dancing.
regatonSubtitle: Reggaeton is not a traditional partner social dance, but an urban solo dance inspired by the Latin American music genre of the same name. It is performed with energetic, sensual, and expressive hip and body movements, usually in a group or solo
regatonSubSubtitle: Reggaeton dance is explosive, modern, and full of attitude — ideal for self-expression, releasing energy, and dancing without rules.
ruedaDeCasinoSubtitle: Rueda de Casino is a group form of salsa originating from Cuba, where multiple dance couples form a circle under the guidance of a leader who calls out the moves. Partners constantly rotate, and the movements are synchronized, playful, and full of surprises
ruedaDeCasinoSubSubtitle: This dance style creates a sense of community, rhythm, and continuous interaction - ideal for anyone who wants to dance, laugh, and be part of a true Cuban atmosphere.
soloGroupsInfo: Solo, duo, and formation dancing represent a special branch of sport and stage dance, where individuality, synchronization, and stage artistry are equally important. Performances may be individual (boys or girls), in pairs without physical contact (duo), group performances, or complex formations with multiple dance couples.Choreographies are performed in various styles — from Standard and Latin to Caribbean and show dances.Our dancers compete in the national A and B leagues as members of TSFM (Dance Sport Federation of Macedonia), and in International, European, and World Championships as members of WDSF (World DanceSport Federation), under whose rules our choreographies are performed.
soloDuoSubtitle: Solo and duo dancing allow each dancer to individually express their technique, energy, and emotion. Through carefully designed choreographies, competitors perform without partner contact in styles such as salsa, bachata, cha-cha-cha, rumba, and others.These performances are an excellent opportunity to build stage confidence, control, and a personal stage identity.
soloDuoSubSubtitle: In our club, we actively prepare young dancers for solo and duo competitions — both nationally and internationally.
soloDuoSubSubSubtitle: Our dancers compete in the national A and B leagues as members of TSFM (Dance Sport Federation of Macedonia) and in International, European, and World Championships as members of WDSF (World DanceSport Federation), following the regulations under which our choreographies are performed.
formAndLaSubtitle: Formation dancing is a dynamic and visually attractive discipline in which groups of dancers — either in couples or all-girl teams — perform synchronized choreographies consisting of five dances.It is performed as LA (Latin) or ST (Standard) formation, with coordinated costumes and stage presentation in accordance with WDSF rules.
formAndLaSubSubtitle: Our dancers compete in the national A and B leagues as members of TSFM (Dance Sport Federation of Macedonia) and in international, European, and World Championships as members of WDSF (World DanceSport Federation), following the official competition rules.
weddingDanceInfo: The wedding dance is one of the most emotional and photographed moments of your big day. Through wedding dance lessons, we will help you create a choreography that perfectly matches your music, style, and story as a couple. Whether you want a classic waltz, a modern romantic dance, or something fun and surprising – we are here to guide you step by step.
createdForYouSubtitle: Our lessons are tailored to your pace, experience, and wishes. We work in a pleasant and relaxed atmosphere, focusing on communication between partners and building confidence on the dance floor.
createdForYouSubSubtitle: If you would like to include guests, best man and maid of honor, or even a surprise group choreography – we also offer additional packages. Let your first dance be a magical moment you will remember forever.
streetDanceInfo: Street dance is an urban form of dance that developed from street culture and is performed with freedom, attitude, and a strong connection to music. It combines different styles such as hip hop - known for rhythmic steps and individual expression, ragga jam - inspired by Jamaican dancehall movements with feminine energy and attitude, and break dance - an acrobatic and athletic style featuring power moves and footwork.These styles are more than just dance - they represent movement, community, and free artistic expression in motion.
hipHopSubtitle: Hip Hop dance is an energetic, modern, and constantly evolving style that follows the latest music and street trends. It is characterized by rhythmic movements, strong groove, contrast between fast and slow segments, and emphasis on personal style and expression.It can be danced solo, in groups, or in battle format.
hipHopSubSubtitle: This style is ideal for young people and anyone who wants to move freely and express their attitude.
raggaJamSubtitle: Ragga Jam is an explosive fusion of reggae-dancehall and hip hop elements. It originates from the street culture of Jamaica and France and is characterized by energetic and rhythmic movements of the hips, chest, and entire body.
raggaJamSubSubtitle: It is danced to reggae and dancehall music, with a strong sense of attitude and stage presence. Ragga Jam is a powerful and fun dance style that celebrates energy, body freedom, and a positive spirit
breakDanceSubtitle: Break Dance is an acrobatic and athletic street dance that includes elements such as toprock, footwork, power moves, and freezes. It originated in the 1970s in the Bronx, New York, and represents one of the four main elements of Hip hop culture.
breakDanceSubSubtitle: This style requires strength, coordination, rhythm, and creativity, and is most often performed in battles or stage performances. Break Dance offers a unique form of self-expression through movements that seem to defy gravity.
whatAreStandardDancesInfo: Standard dances are an elegant and technically demanding discipline within ballroom sport dancing. They are part of the official competitive system of the World DanceSport Federation (WDSF), which has been setting the highest standards in the world of dance since 1957.The English Waltz, Viennese Waltz, Slowfox, Quickstep, and Tango are taught using precise methodology and are judged according to strict WDSF criteria. At Dance Sport Club “Branimir & Brankica,” these dances are taught by a professional team with international experience, aiming to help every dancer reach their full potential - whether recreationally or competitively.
englishWaltzSubtitle: The English Waltz is known for its smooth, flowing movements and the characteristic “rise and fall” technique. It is performed at a slow tempo, creating the feeling of gliding across the dance floor.
englishWaltzSubSubtitle: It forms the foundation of all standard dances and is ideal for developing a strong dance frame, musicality, and grace.
tangoSubtitle: Tango is a passionate and dramatic dance characterized by sharp, controlled movements and strong visual expression. Unlike the other standard dances, it does not include “rise and fall,” but is danced low to the floor, with precise footwork and constant tension between the partners.
tangoSubSubtitle: It is a dance that demands precision, emotion, and strong stage presence.
vienneseWaltzSubtitle: The Viennese Waltz is the fastest of the waltzes and is performed with continuous turns and circular movements in a 3/4 rhythm.
vienneseWaltzSubSubtitle: It creates a spectacular visual effect and requires excellent control, orientation, and physical endurance. Its traditional form and dynamic character make it a favorite both on stage and in the ballroom.
slowfoxSubtitle: Slowfox is one of the most technically precise and challenging dances in the standard category. It is characterized by smooth, gliding movements and long, flowing steps with constant motion.
slowfoxSubSubtitle: Although the tempo is slow, control and synchronization between partners must be flawless. This dance requires maturity, stability, and impeccable technique.
quickstepSubtitle: Quickstep is a fast, joyful, and lively dance featuring complex rhythm patterns, quick steps, and energetic movements. Although it belongs to the standard category, it has a dynamic quality that often resembles a show dance, combining liveliness with elegance.
quickstepSubSubtitle: It is ideal for demonstrating lightness, speed, and the playful character of the couple.
meunaInfo: MEUNA opens the vision of reality beyond the everyday SELF and reveals the boundless space of your true being. During MEUNA sessions and meditations, you are guided through spiritual exercises, step by step, from everyday awareness to higher levels of consciousness. At a certain point, you enter a state of ABSOLUTE EMPTINESS and, with full awareness, directly experience the TRUTH — your natural state.
discoverSubtitle: MEUNA opens the vision of reality beyond the everyday SELF and reveals the infinite space of your true being.
discoverSubSubtitle: In MEUNA sessions and meditations, you are guided through spiritual exercises step by step, moving from ordinary awareness to higher states of consciousness. At one moment, you enter a state of ABSOLUTE EMPTINESS and, with full awareness, directly experience the TRUTH - your natural state.
realizeNatureSubtitle: All human experiences merge into ONE, which is our true nature. Through the ONE, we gradually free consciousness from the perception of duality between ourselves and the world. Through the ONE, the quality of everyday life improves, and the practitioner’s spiritual evolution accelerates.
realizeNatureSubSubtitle: The methods of these exercises are simple, fast, and accessible to everyone. They function in a controlled and predictable way.
